title: Wahoo collection removal not working
symptom: After pairing a Wahoo Bolt bike computer with a Dexcom G6 to display BG readings, the user cannot remove the collection from an old Wahoo device. Using the Start USB Configuration command with xDrip collector disabled does not work; the BG value continues to be displayed.
evidence_quote: I have used Start USB Configuration command with xdrip collector disabled as suggested in the wiki, but it doesn't work. The BG value continues to be displayed.
